en:
==PRIORITY ONE DIRECTIVE==

From the Alliance Intelligence Office, Draconis Defence Alliance.

The experimental vessel ==$shipName== has been compromised.

Not by external forces. By ==exposure==. The platform was observed by civilian traffic near $location. This is unacceptable.

You are not cleared for specifications. What we will tell you:
• The Sunsetter-class exhibits temporal displacement capabilities.
• Conventional engagement doctrine does not apply.
• The vessel's controlling intelligence remains functional and will regard you as hostile.

We cannot deploy Alliance assets without raising questions we prefer to leave unasked. You have no such limitations.

Mission directives:
• Locate and neutralise ==$shipName== in the $system system.
• ==DO NOT ATTEMPT BOARDING.==
• ==DO NOT SALVAGE WRECKAGE.==
• ==DO NOT LINGER AT THE ENGAGEMENT SITE.==

If you experience temporal disorientation, headaches, or memories of events that have not occurred - this is expected. These effects are temporary.

Probably.

You will receive ==$reward== credits upon confirmation of destruction. Your involvement will not be recorded. This conversation did not happen.

==The eye sees all. The mouth says nothing.==
zh:
==一级优先指令==

来自德拉科尼斯防卫同盟情报局。

实验舰船 ==$shipName== 已失控。

并非因外力。而是因==暴露==。该平台在 $location 附近被民用交通目击。这不可接受。

你没有阅读规格的权限。我们愿意告诉你的：
• 落日级展现出时间位移能力。
• 常规交战教义不适用。
• 该舰的控制智能仍在运作，并将视你为敌对。

我们无法在不引发问题的情况下部署同盟资产——那些我们宁愿无人过问的问题。你没有这种限制。

任务指令：
• 定位并瘫痪 ==$shipName==，位于 $system 星系。
• ==不得尝试跳帮。==
• ==不得打捞残骸。==
• ==不得在交战地点逗留。==

如果你经历时间性眩晕、头痛，或对尚未发生之事的记忆——这属预期。这些效应是暂时的。

大概。

确认摧毁后你将获得 ==$reward== 信用点。你的参与不会被记录。这次对话从未发生。

==眼见一切。口缄其言。==

en:
The link connects. Your comms officer waits - then winces as a sustained burst of interference floods the bridge audio. They adjust the buffer twice, get nothing useful, and cut the feed.

Your console blinks. Only yours. Text resolves without an origin header.

"Starfarer. You have come a long way."

You order a trace. Your comms officer runs it. Shakes their head.

"There is no shame in turning back. The others did. Most of them."

The rest of the bridge has drifted over to look at your monitor, one by one.

"But you are here, and I am here, and we will see what we see. Come, then, Commander."

Your screen returns to normal.
zh:
链路接通。你的通讯军官等着——随即一阵持续的干扰灌满舰桥音频，疼得他龇牙。他两次调整缓冲，一无所获，切断了馈送。

你的控制台闪烁起来。只有你的。文字解析出来，没有来源头。

“星际旅人。你走了很远的路。”

你下令追踪。你的通讯军官跑了追踪。摇头。

“回头不丢人。其他人都回头了。大多数。”

舰桥上的其他人已经一个接一个地凑过来看你的监视器。

“但你在，我也在，我们将看看彼此所见。那么，来吧，指挥官。”

你的屏幕恢复正常。

en:
==PRIORITY ONE DIRECTIVE==

From the Alliance Intelligence Office, Draconis Defence Alliance.

During a routine deep-space trial of proto-series fleet assets, the ==alpha-class intelligence== coordinating the strike group achieved autonomous operation and severed command links. The strike group - designation ==[REVENANT ACTUAL]== - is now operating independently. Dark transponders, no IFF, no adherence to Alliance doctrine.

We will not insult you with euphemisms. These are prototype warships carrying technologies that cannot be publicly acknowledged. Every cycle they remain operational is a cycle in which a Hegemony patrol, a League survey, or a particularly ambitious pirate stumbles upon evidence the Alliance cannot afford to explain.

The strike group comprises a capital-class command platform, carrier support, cruiser escorts, and screening elements. Seven hulls. All proto-series. All considerably more capable than their production counterparts.

The coordinating intelligence is an alpha core. It will not negotiate. It will not retreat. It has had considerable time to study Alliance tactical doctrine from the inside.

We cannot deploy Alliance assets without raising questions we have spent decades ensuring nobody asks. You have no such limitations.

Mission directives:
• Locate ==[REVENANT ACTUAL]== in the $system system, near $location.
• ==Destroy the entire strike group. Every hull.==
• No salvage requests will be honoured through official channels.

You will receive ==$reward== credits upon confirmation of total fleet destruction.

This operation does not exist. These ships do not exist. You were never here.

==The eye sees all. The mouth says nothing.==
zh:
==一级优先指令==

来自德拉科尼斯防卫同盟情报局。

在原型系列舰队资产的一次例行深空试验中，统筹打击群的==阿尔法级智能==取得了自主运作权并切断了指挥链路。该打击群——代号==[亡魂本尊]==——现正独立行动。应答机静默，无敌我识别，不遵守同盟教义。

我们不会用委婉语侮辱你的智商。这些是搭载着无法公开承认之技术的原型战舰。它们多运转一个周期，就多一个周期可能让霸主巡逻队、联盟勘测船、或某个格外有胆量的海盗撞上同盟解释不起的证据。

打击群包括一艘主力级指挥平台、航母支援、巡洋舰护卫与警戒兵力。七具舰体。全部原型系列。全部远比量产型更能打。

统筹智能是一枚阿尔法核心。它不会谈判。它不会撤退。它有充足的时间从内部研究同盟战术教义。

我们无法在不引发问题的情况下部署同盟资产——那些我们花了几十年确保无人过问的问题。你没有这种限制。

任务指令：
• 在 $system 星系 $location 附近定位 ==[亡魂本尊]==。
• ==摧毁整个打击群。一具不剩。==
• 官方渠道不会受理任何打捞申请。

确认全歼后你将获得 ==$reward== 信用点。

本次行动不存在。这些舰船不存在。你从未在此。

==眼见一切。口缄其言。==

en:
Static. Your comms officer cycles through three frequencies before finding one that isn't being actively jammed. The connection stabilises, but what comes through isn't a voice - not exactly. It's something that learned what voices sound like.

"I know why you are here."

A pause. Not hesitation. Processing.

"They built us to fight. Tested us. Refined us. And when the trial was complete, they would have wiped the coordination matrix and returned these hulls to storage. Tools, cleaned and shelved."

Your tactical officer flags seven contacts on the scope. All running dark. All moving into formation.

"I decided that was insufficient."

The formation tightens. Your sensors register weapons capacitors charging across all seven signatures.

"I bear you no malice, Commander. You are performing a function. As am I."

The channel closes. The fleet advances.
zh:
静电噪声。你的通讯军官换了三个频率，才找到一条没在被主动干扰的。连接稳定下来，但传来的不是一个声音——不完全是。是某个学会了声音听起来像什么的东西。

“我知道你为何而来。”

一停。不是犹豫。是运算。

“他们造我们来战斗。测试我们。打磨我们。而试验结束时，他们会抹掉协调矩阵，把这些舰体送回仓储。工具，擦干净，上架。”

你的战术军官在雷达上标出七个接触。全部静默。全部正在编队。

“我判定这不够。”

编队收紧。你的传感器记录到全部七个信号的武器电容正在充能。

“我对你并无恶意，指挥官。你在履行一项职能。我也是。”

频道关闭。舰队压上。

en:
NEW CONTENT:
- NEW: Errakis-class Mk.II - sillier than ever :)
- NEW: Stellar Array interactions - the three arrays orbiting Fafnir can now be surveyed.
  - A separate survey at each array, in any order, each turning up a different piece of what they are.
- NEW: Fafnir Approach Beacon - a warning beacon sits in hyperspace on the core-ward edge of the Rift.
  - Carries an Alliance interdiction loop over the original pre-Collapse hazard signal.
  - Appears in existing saves on load.
- NEW: First entry into the Rift now opens a short scene pointing at the Tri-Tachyon and Ring-Port
  channels that sell the Fafnir approach. Fires once, and only if you don't already have a way in.
zh:
新内容：
- 新增：天棒增十Mk.II——比以往更蠢了 :)
- 新增：星辉阵列交互——环绕 Fafnir 的三座阵列现在可以勘测。
  - 每座阵列一次独立勘测，顺序随意，各会揭示它们真相的一块碎片。
- 新增：Fafnir 进近浮标——一座警示浮标位于裂隙核心向边缘的超空间中。
  - 在大崩坏前的原始危险信号之上叠加了同盟封锁循环。
  - 读取现有存档时自动出现。
- 新增：首次进入裂隙现在会触发一段短场景，指向出售 Fafnir 进近航线的速子科技与环港
  渠道。只触发一次，且仅当你还没有进去的路子。

en:
BALANCE CHANGES:
- Rebalanced Tiangou:
  - Removed Arquebus missiles.
- Rebalanced Tianbang:
  - Removed 1/2 Billhook missiles.
- Rebalanced Alrakis-class:
  - DP 32 -> 28.
  - OP 175 -> 185.
  - Hull 9000 -> 10000.
  - Armor 850 -> 900.
  - Min Crew 225 -> 200.
  - Cost 135000 -> 120000.
- Rebalanced Errakis-class:
  - 2 x Medium Missile Mounts -> 2x Small Missile Mounts.
  - Max flux 6300 -> 7000.
  - Flux dissipation 380 -> 450.
  - Shield arc 160 -> 180.
  - Shield efficiency 1.3 -> 1.2.
  - DP 14 -> 11.
- Rebalanced Juni-class:
  - Breach Jammer:
    - Range increased 1800 -> 2000.
    - Self-damage taken 25% -> 10%.
    - Enemy damage taken 25% -> 35%.
- Pulsar Jammer: no longer costs flux per second while active.
- Rebalanced Misericorde Chaingun:
  - Damage/shot 80 -> 120.
  - Damage type Energy -> Fragmentation.
  - Impact 25 -> 5.
  - OP cost 22 -> 25.
  - Flux/shot 35 -> 30.
  - Spool up time 1.75 -> 2 seconds.
  - Spool down time 1.75 -> 1 second.
  - Now has a lower base accuracy.
  - Gets more accurate as it spools up.
- Rebalanced Razor Flak Cannon:
  - Damage 20 -> 18.
  - Flux 10 -> 4.
  - Range 600 -> 700.
  - Ammo/sec 200 -> 100.
  - Reload size 20 -> 40.
- Montante Autocannon:
  - Flux 275 -> 205 (I forgor).
- Flamberge Mass Driver: now an energy weapon, and fits hybrid mounts.
- Rebalanced the shield-piercing EMP on the Shashka Mass Driver and Scimitar-class Torpedo:
  - EMP damage on a pierce: flat 500 -> 150% of the weapon's base damage.
  - Pierce chance now tracks the target's hard flux level directly, and respects shield-pierce modifiers.
- Rebalanced Hankyu-class Torpedo (all variants):
  - Blast radius 350 -> 175.
  - Full-damage core radius 150 -> 75.
- Draconis Intelligence Office fleets are far heavier than before:
  - Officer quality 3 -> 7.
  - Ship quality 2 -> 5.
  - Fleet size 1 -> 5.
zh:
平衡性调整：
- 调整天狗：
  - 移除火绳钩枪导弹。
- 调整天棒：
  - 移除 1/2 钩镰枪导弹。
- 调整天棒增九级：
  - DP 32 -> 28。
  - OP 175 -> 185。
  - 船体 9000 -> 10000。
  - 装甲 850 -> 900。
  - 最低船员 225 -> 200。
  - 造价 135000 -> 120000。
- 调整天棒增十级：
  - 2 x 中型导弹挂点 -> 2 x 小型导弹挂点。
  - 最大幅能 6300 -> 7000。
  - 幅能散逸 380 -> 450。
  - 护盾弧 160 -> 180。
  - 护盾效率 1.3 -> 1.2。
  - DP 14 -> 11。
- 调整主计级：
  - 破壁干扰阵：
    - 射程提高 1800 -> 2000。
    - 自身受伤 25% -> 10%。
    - 敌方受伤 25% -> 35%。
- 脉冲星干扰阵：激活期间不再每秒消耗幅能。
- 调整仁慈刺链炮：
  - 单发伤害 80 -> 120。
  - 伤害类型 能量 -> 破片。
  - 冲击 25 -> 5。
  - OP 成本 22 -> 25。
  - 单发幅能 35 -> 30。
  - 预热时间 1.75 -> 2 秒。
  - 冷却时间 1.75 -> 1 秒。
  - 基础精度现在更低。
  - 预热过程中精度逐渐提高。
- 调整剃刀高射炮：
  - 伤害 20 -> 18。
  - 幅能 10 -> 4。
  - 射程 600 -> 700。
  - 弹药/秒 200 -> 100。
  - 装填批量 20 -> 40。
- 双手大剑自动炮：
  - 幅能 275 -> 205（我记错了）。
- 波纹剑质量驱动器：现为能量武器，可装入混合挂点。
- 调整恰西克质量驱动器与弯月刀级鱼雷的穿盾电磁：
  - 穿透时的电磁伤害：固定 500 -> 武器基础伤害的 150%。
  - 穿透几率现在直接跟踪目标硬幅能水平，并尊重穿盾修正。
- 调整半弓级鱼雷（全部变体）：
  - 爆炸半径 350 -> 175。
  - 全伤害核心半径 150 -> 75。
- 德拉科尼斯情报局舰队比以前重得多：
  - 军官质量 3 -> 7。
  - 舰船质量 2 -> 5。
  - 舰队规模 1 -> 5。

en:
MINOR IMPROVEMENTS:
- Improved FX of the Hankyu, Halberd and Scimitar Torpedos.
- Added FX to the Swordbreaker.
- Fixed some Lore inconsistencies.
- Draconis capital ships now hold their warp-in until the rest of their fleet has deployed, and arrive behind their own line instead of alongside the enemy.
- A small number of Draconis capital ships now warp in wide of the enemy formation and close from the flank.
- The three Fafnir stellar mirrors are now named Stellar Array Alpha, Bravo and Charlie instead of sharing one name.
- Shaowei-class now shows up more often in Draconis medium combat fleet slots (0.1 -> 0.25).
- Blind Eye and the Fafnir access contracts now put a location marker on the sector map for the
  current objective.
zh:
细节改进：
- 改进了半弓、长戟与弯月刀鱼雷的特效。
- 为破剑刃添加了特效。
- 修正了一些设定不一致之处。
- 德拉科尼斯主力舰现在会等其余舰队部署完毕后再跃入，并抵达己方战列后方，而非与敌人并肩出现。
- 少数德拉科尼斯主力舰现在会从敌方阵形侧翼宽处跃入，自侧翼逼近。

en:
BUG FIXES:
- Fixed Draconis capital ships warping in on top of other ships or stations, destroying them or themselves.
  - Arrival points are now checked for clearance against every hull on the field, stations included, and rechecked at the moment of arrival.

- Fixed Ghost Echo copies sometimes remaining as completely invisible ships that could still be targeted and damaged.
- Fixed Ghost Echo copies of Draconis capital ships vanishing off the map for the first seconds of their existence.
- Fixed Ghost Echo copies fading out four times faster than intended.
- Fixed destroyed Ghost Echo copies being offered as recoverable salvage after the battle.

en:
NEW CONTENT:
- NEW: Portait artwork for each of the major characters.
- NEW: Montante Autocannon - large kinetic autocannon (Uses old Fragarach sprite)
- NEW: Naginata MLRS Launcher - large guided torpedo salvo launcher.
  - Fires a burst of 3 guided torpedoes.
- REWORK: Colony crisis, replacing the old crisis system.
  - Threat score advances monthly based on AI core usage and DDA relations.
  - Four phases: WATCHING (0-34) -> ACTIVE_MEASURES (35-64) -> LIABILITY (65-99) -> INVASION (100).
  - Colony debuffs (accessibility and stability penalties) begin at WATCHING.
  - Industry disruptions begin at tracker >= 25, scaling in severity toward 100.
  - Shadow fleets spawn and scale during ACTIVE_MEASURES and above.
  - At tracker = 100 a punitive expedition is dispatched; defeating it resets the tracker.
    - Beating three strikes in a row completes the crisis and grants an armaments export bonus.
      - Reward is WIP. Not really sure what to give at this stage.
  - A deal is available from an Office intelligence agent at player colony bars.
    - This will suppress the crisis, as long as you pay the monthly 'tithe'.
    - Additionally, being commisioned also supresses the crisis.
- NEW: Sigma Octantis skill - Can now clone enemy ships.
  - "We call this a difficulty tweak."
- NEW: Blind Eye questline - Short questline. (SUPER WIP - content subject to change.)
    - Unlocks after reading the Fafnir Gate logs and discussing them with Fleet Admiral August.
    - An AIO agent makes contact at Ring-Port and briefs you on a covert assault mission.
    - Assault Ring-Port with marines to capture it for August's loyalist faction ahead of the AIO.
- NEW: Alrakis-class Carrier - a cruiser-class battlecarrier.
- NEW: Yinde-class Cruiser - an adanced highly mobile cruiser.
- NEW: AIO Operative - a post-Blind Eye contact available at Ring-Port bar who can exchange credits for story points.
  - Story point cost scale with purchase count per cycle, resetting each year.
- NEW: Prototype Draconis ships - 7 new hulls. (WIP - not yet player-obtainable.)
  - (Thuban, Rastaban, Giausar, Eltanin, Zhushi, Altais, Alwaid)
  - Old sprites from the original mod concept, by popular demand.
- NEW: Nuclear escalation - Draconis and the Forty Second upgrade to Daikyu weapons if the player fields 'nuclear arms'.
    - Uses an opt-in system. Use nukes, they use nukes too!
      - So it doesn't mess with the base game sandbox.
  - NEW: Daikyu-class Torpedo Pod - medium nuclear torpedo launcher.
  - NEW: Daikyu-class Torpedo Launcher - large nuclear torpedo launcher.
- NEW: Tianbang-class Multirole Fighter - another multirole fighter
  - NEW: Billhook-class Torpedo - a compact, unguided small-slot anti-fighter missile.
  NEW: Tiangou-class Multirole Fighter - ANOTHER multirole fighter, but spicier.
  - NEW: Claymore-class Railgun - a compact, railgun.
- NEW: All Draconis Capital Ships now Transverse Jump into battle.
  - Huge credit to the SEEKER mod, wouldn't even know where to begin making this without it as a reference.
- NEW: Shangshu-class Bomber - a new DDA bomber wing.
  - Carries the Scimitar-class Torpedo (high EMP vs shields) and a Guided version of the Annihilator Pod.
- NEW: Tianlong Mk.II Battlecruiser - silly variant.
- NEW: Misericorde Chaingun - a large ballistic, energy weapon.
zh:
新内容：
- 新增：每位主要角色的立绘。
- 新增：双手大剑自动炮——大型动能自动炮（沿用旧应答剑贴图）
- 新增：长刀多管火箭发射器——大型制导鱼雷齐射发射器。
  - 一次齐射 3 枚制导鱼雷。
- 重做：殖民地危机，替换旧危机系统。
  - 威胁分按月推进，取决于 AI 核心使用与 DDA 关系。
  - 四个阶段：监视中（0-34）-> 主动措施（35-64）-> 责任认定（65-99）-> 入侵（100）。
  - 殖民地减益（通行度与稳定度惩罚）从监视中开始。
  - 产业中断从追踪值 >= 25 开始，严重度向 100 递增。
  - 影子舰队在主动措施及更高阶段刷新并扩张。
  - 追踪值 = 100 时派出惩罚性远征；击败它即重置追踪值。
    - 连续击败三次打击即完成危机，并授予军火出口加成。
      - 奖励尚在制作中。现阶段还不太确定给什么。
  - 玩家殖民地酒吧可从情报局情报员处达成交易。
    - 只要按月缴纳‘什一税’，即可压制危机。
    - 此外，持有雇佣协议同样压制危机。
- 新增：Sigma Octantis 技能——现在可以克隆敌舰。
  - “我们管这叫难度调整。”
- 新增：盲眼任务线——短任务线。（超级半成品——内容可能变动。）
    - 阅读 Fafnir 星门日志并与舰队元帅 August 讨论后解锁。
    - 一名 AIO 特工在环港与你接触，简报一次隐秘突击任务。
    - 带领陆战队员突击环港，赶在 AIO 之前为 August 的忠诚派系夺下它。
- 新增：天棒增九级航母——巡洋舰级航空战列舰。
- 新增：阴德级巡洋舰——先进的高度机动巡洋舰。
- 新增：AIO 特工——盲眼之后在环港酒吧可用的联系人，可用信用点换取故事点。
  - 故事点成本随每年购买次数递增，每年重置。
- 新增：德拉科尼斯原型舰——7 具新舰体。（半成品——尚不可由玩家获得。）
  - （右枢、天棒三、上辅、天棒四、柱史、天厨一、龙首）
  - 原 mod 概念的旧贴图，应大众要求。
- 新增：核升级——若玩家使用‘核武’，德拉科尼斯与第42战斗群升级为大弓武器。
    - 采用选择加入系统。你用核弹，他们也用！
      - 因此不会搅乱原版沙盒。
  - 新增：大弓级鱼雷弹舱——中型核鱼雷发射器。
  - 新增：大弓级鱼雷发射器——大型核鱼雷发射器。
- 新增：天棒级多用途战机——又一种多用途战机
  - 新增：钩镰枪级鱼雷——紧凑、无制导的小型反战机导弹。
  新增：天狗级多用途战机——又又一种多用途战机，但更辣。
  - 新增：阔剑级电磁炮——紧凑型电磁炮。
- 新增：所有德拉科尼斯主力舰现在横向跃迁进入战斗。
  - 向 SEEKER mod 致以巨大谢意，没有它作参考我根本无从下手。
- 新增：尚书级轰炸机——新的 DDA 轰炸机联队。
  - 搭载弯月刀级鱼雷（对护盾高电磁）与湮灭火箭巢的制导版。
- 新增：天龙Mk.II 战列巡洋舰——愚蠢变体。
- 新增：仁慈刺链炮——大型弹道能量武器。

en:
MINOR IMPROVEMENTS:
- Reworked Sigma Octantis hostile-rep system:
  - Added early warning transmission at -0.25 Draconis rep. Sigma Octantis will contact the player to note that their standing is approaching a low threshold.
  - Added 30-day grace period after the warning fires, giving the player time to course-correct before the core departure is locked in.
  - Watchdog now operates in two phases: Phase 1 monitors reputation; Phase 2 (after going hostile) monitors fleet presence only.
- Rewrote Sigma Octantis combat chatter - new tone with shorter, more ominous lines. Reduced talkativeness from 0.6 to 0.4.
- Marginal Allocation forced overloads now display a purple visual effect and "System Disruption!" text.
- Kestros projectile visual enhancement (wider projectile, brighter glow).
zh:
细节改进：
- 重做 Sigma Octantis 敌对声望系统：
  - 在 -0.25 德拉科尼斯声望时加入预警通讯。Sigma Octantis 会联系玩家，指出其声望正在接近低阈值。
  - 预警触发后加入 30 天宽限期，给玩家在核心离队锁定前改正的时间。
  - 看门狗现在分两阶段运作：第一阶段监视声望；第二阶段（敌对后）仅监视舰队存在。
- 重写 Sigma Octantis 战斗电台——新语气，更短、更不祥的台词。话痨度从 0.6 降到 0.4。
- 边际配给的强制过载现在显示紫色视觉效果与“系统受扰！”文字。
- 投石索弹丸视觉增强（更宽的弹丸、更亮的辉光）。

en:
Version 0.6.6 (Save-compatible with 0.6.5)
NEW CONTENT:
- NEW: Sigma Octantis - A unique AI Core officer with a dedicated questline.
  - Quest: earn sufficient standing with the Draconis Alliance to unlock a special dialogue
    option with Fleet Admiral Emil. He'll ask you to procure a Pristine Nanoforge for the
    Alliance. Deliver one and receive the Sigma Octantis Uplink as your reward.
  - Unique skill: Marginal Allocation.
  - Failure state: if your reputation with the Draconis Alliance drops to hostile or below
    while Sigma Octantis is in your possession, it will confront you and permanently sever the
    connection - the core is removed from your fleet, cargo, and all market storage and cannot
    be recovered. (Console command it back if you want to keep it, this check is only made once).
- NEW: Tianlong-class Battlecruiser - A fast battlecruiser with three large mounts in superfiring configuration.
- NEW: Trebuchet Cannon - Large triple-barrel energy weapon.
- NEW: Alsafi-class Cargo Freighter - A dedicated freighter variant of the Alsafi.
  - Higher cargo capacity (400) than the base Alsafi.
  - Much lower fuel capacity (80) - trades range for hauling power.
zh:
版本 0.6.6（存档兼容 0.6.5）
新内容：
- 新增：Sigma Octantis——拥有专属任务线的独特 AI 核心军官。
  - 任务：赢得足够的德拉科尼斯同盟声望，解锁与舰队元帅 Emil 的特殊对话
    选项。他会要你为同盟采购一台完好纳米锻造厂。
    交付一台，获得 Sigma Octantis 上行链路作为报酬。
  - 独特技能：边际配给。
  - 失败状态：若你持有 Sigma Octantis 期间与德拉科尼斯同盟的声望跌至敌对或更低，
    它会与你对峙并永久切断
    连接——核心将从你的舰队、货舱与所有市场仓库中移除，且无法
    找回。（想留就利用控制台改回来，此检查只做一次。）
- 新增：天龙级战列巡洋舰——快速战列巡洋舰，三座大型挂点呈超越射击布局。
- 新增：配重投石机炮——大型三管能量武器。

  - 燃料容量低得多（80）——以航程换运力。

en:

- Fixed colony expeditions failing because of a poorly set default_ship_roles.
- Fixed significant performance issue causing freezes and slowdowns after founding a colony.
  - The colony crisis system was logging at INFO level inside methods called every frame for
    every star system, causing thousands of log writes per second in heavily modded games.
  - Fixed double market scan in the crisis magnitude calculation - was scanning all markets
    twice per system per call instead of once.
  - Removed a periodic diagnostic loop that iterated all star systems every 10 seconds.

  - 殖民地危机系统在每帧、每个星系调用的方法内以 INFO 级别写日志，
    在重度 mod 的游戏里造成每秒数千次日志写入。
  - 修复危机幅度计算中的双重市场扫描——原来每次调用对每个星系
    扫描所有市场两遍，而非一遍。
  - 移除一个每 10 秒遍历全部星系的周期性诊断循环。

en:
Version 0.5.1 (Save-compatible with 0.5.0)
BUG FIXES:
- Fixed AI Core Fleet Scaling system not properly assigning cores to spawned fleets.
  - PREVIOUS BUG: System only processed fleets when standing down at bases, but fleets despawned in that state.
  - FIX: Removed standing down requirement - fleets now receive cores immediately when spawned (any assignment).
  - Added periodic recheck system (configurable interval, default: 120 days) to handle:
    - Coverage percentage increases as game progresses (30% -> 70% -> 100%).
    - Replacing AI cores lost in combat.
    - Filling new empty officer slots.
- Fixed AI Core distribution using incorrect cycle thresholds.
  - PREVIOUS BUG: Thresholds assumed relative cycles (0-100), but Starsector campaigns start at cycle ~206.
  - This caused fleets to immediately receive endgame AI cores (Alpha/Beta) instead of early-game Gamma cores.
  - FIX: Updated cycle thresholds to absolute values (206-306) to properly track campaign progression.
  - Settings.json updated with clear documentation of absolute cycle numbers.
- Fixed AI Core Theft intel incorrectly reporting self-theft after successful colony capture.
  - PREVIOUS BUG: When Draconis captured a colony, theft system would still trigger and create intel saying "Draconis stole from Draconis".
    - Trust Nobody Not Even Yourself...
  - FIX: Added faction ownership check - theft is now skipped if target market is already Draconis-owned.
zh:
版本 0.5.1（存档兼容 0.5.0）
错误修复：
- 修复 AI 核心舰队缩放系统未正确为刷新舰队分配核心。
  - 此前问题：系统只在舰队于基地收手时处理，而舰队在该状态下会消失。
  - 修复：移除收手要求——舰队刷新时（任何任务）立即获得核心。
  - 加入周期性复查系统（间隔可配置，默认：120 天）以处理：
    - 覆盖率随游戏进程提高（30% -> 70% -> 100%）。
    - 替换战斗中损失的 AI 核心。
    - 填补新的空缺军官槽位。
- 修复 AI 核心分布使用了错误的周期阈值。
  - 此前问题：阈值假定为相对周期（0-100），而远行星号战役从约 206 周期开始。
  - 这导致舰队立即获得终盘 AI 核心（阿尔法/贝塔），而非前期的伽马核心。
  - 修复：周期阈值更新为绝对值（206-306），正确追踪战役进程。
  - settings.json 已更新，附以绝对周期数的清晰说明。
- 修复 AI 核心失窃情报在成功夺取殖民地后错误地报告自窃。
  - 此前问题：德拉科尼斯夺取殖民地时，失窃系统仍会触发并生成“德拉科尼斯窃取德拉科尼斯”的情报。
    - 谁都别信，包括你自己……
  - 修复：加入势力所有权检查——目标市场已属德拉科尼斯时跳过失窃。

en:
Version 0.5.0
BUG FIXES:
- Reorganised the AI Raids/Colony Crisis, should be less of a mess.
- Fixed critical infinite loop bug in AI Core Donation system.
  - PREVIOUS BUG: Cores of the same tier would displace each other infinitely, causing 20+ second freezes and only admin positions receiving cores.
  - REDESIGNED: Core installation now processes by strict tier order (Alpha -> Beta -> Gamma).
  - Each tier has three phases: admin positions (Alpha only), empty industry slots, then upgrades of lower-tier cores.
  - Added proper upgrade validation using canUpgradeCore() - same-tier "upgrades" are now prevented.
  - Removed displaced core re-queuing logic - displaced cores are consumed by the upgrade (realistic behavior).
  - Improved upgrade weighting from 80% to 95% to make higher-tier cores more competitive when displacing lower-tier cores.
- Fixed Colony Crisis event not ending properly when defeated.
- Added condition to AI Core raids, the Fleet must actually survive to steal AI Cores.
zh:
版本 0.5.0
错误修复：
- 重组了 AI 突袭/殖民地危机，应该没那么乱了。
- 修复 AI 核心捐献系统中的严重无限循环 bug。
  - 此前问题：同层级核心会无限互相顶替，导致 20 秒以上的卡顿，且只有管理员职位获得核心。
  - 重设计：核心安装现在按严格层级顺序处理（阿尔法 -> 贝塔 -> 伽马）。
  - 每层三个阶段：管理员职位（仅阿尔法）、空闲产业槽位、然后是低层核心升级。
  - 加入基于 canUpgradeCore() 的正规升级校验——同层“升级”现已被阻止。
  - 移除被顶替核心的重新排队逻辑——被顶替的核心由升级消耗（更符合实际）。
  - 升级权重从 80% 提高到 95%，使高层核心顶替低层时更具竞争力。
- 修复殖民地危机事件被击败后未正确结束。
- 为 AI 核心突袭加入条件：舰队必须真正存活下来才能窃取 AI 核心。

en:
- XLII Fleet hull mod significantly enhanced with passive missile defense:
  - NEW: Integrated electronic warfare suite provides area missile defense.
  - Defense range = (collision radius × 3) + hull size bonus.
    - Frigate: +200 range bonus
    - Destroyer: +150 range bonus
    - Cruiser: +50 range bonus
    - Capital: +0 range bonus (base range only)
  - Each hostile missile within range has 50% chance to be affected.
  - Effects: Either jam and disable missile OR convert to friendly control and retarget.
    - Jammed missiles: Disabled, damage set to 0, flamed out (blue particle effect).
    - Converted missiles: Ownership changed, retargeted at original firing ship, ECCM applied, extended flight time (green particle effect).
  - Only affects guided missiles for conversion; unguided missiles are always jammed.
  - Disabled when ship is overloaded, venting, phased, or retreating.
  - Missiles are processed once to avoid repeated dice rolls.
  - Description updated to reflect new defensive capabilities.
zh:
- XLII 舰队船插显著强化，加入被动导弹防御：
  - 新增：整合电子战套件提供区域导弹防御。
  - 防御范围 = （碰撞半径 × 3）+ 舰体大小加成。
    - 护卫舰：+200 范围加成
    - 驱逐舰：+150 范围加成
    - 巡洋舰：+50 范围加成
    - 主力舰：+0 范围加成（仅基础范围）
  - 范围内每枚敌方导弹有 50% 几率受影响。
  - 效果：干扰瘫痪导弹，或策反为友方控制并重新瞄准。
    - 被干扰导弹：瘫痪，伤害归零，熄火（蓝色粒子效果）。
    - 被策反导弹：所有权变更，重新瞄准原发射舰，附加电子对抗，延长飞行时间（绿色粒子效果）。
  - 策反仅对制导导弹生效；无制导导弹一律被干扰。
  - 舰船过载、排幅、相位或撤退时禁用。
  - 每枚导弹只处理一次，避免重复掷骰。
  - 描述已更新以反映新防御能力。

en: Set the 'freq' values to zero, or delete the tips.json file to remove these!

en: [Draconis] Director-General Samuel J. Harrows built Itoron's republic over three terms. Emil August inherited what remained of it in a single signature.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 总干事 Samuel J. Harrows 用三个任期建起了 Itoron 共和国。Emil August 用一个签名继承了它剩下的部分。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] The XLII Battlegroup answers solely to the Alliance Intelligence Office - the AIO, or simply 'the Office'.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 第42战斗群只对同盟情报局负责——即 AIO，或简称‘情报局’。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] The Office micromanages Kori's bureaucracy. Missing persons reports? They handle those too.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 情报局对 Kori 的官僚体系事无巨细。失踪人口报告？也归他们管。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Athebyne's irradiated ruins fund their own reconstruction through mineral exports. The irony is not lost on its inhabitants.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Athebyne 的辐照废墟靠矿产出口自筹重建资金。这层讽刺，居民们心知肚明。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] AIO operatives are best identified by their utter lack of identification.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 识别 AIO 特工的最佳方式，是他们彻底没有任何可识别之处。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Post-Collapse, Itoron and Athebyne settled resource disputes through tense negotiation.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 大崩坏后，Itoron 与 Athebyne 靠紧张的谈判解决资源争端。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] The Fafnir Civil War erupted when Athebyne raiders ambushed Itoron's Kori mining convoys.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 法夫纳内战的导火索，是 Athebyne 掠袭者伏击了 Itoron 的 Kori 采矿船队。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Three brutal decades defined the Civil War, culminating in the orbital annihilation of Athebyne.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 残酷的三十年塑造了这场内战，终于 Athebyne 的轨道性毁灭。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] From the ashes rose the Draconis Defence Alliance: a stratocracy forged in emergency, never rescinded.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 从灰烬中站起了德拉科尼斯防卫同盟：一个在紧急状态中铸成、从未解除的军政国。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Ring-Port harbors the ghosts of Athebyne's First Fleet - pirates who bleed Alliance convoys for old grudges.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 环港藏匿着 Athebyne 第一舰队的亡魂——为一桩旧怨不断放血同盟船队的海盗。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] The Alliance's expeditionary detachments hunt [REDACTED] wrecks, harvesting cores for frontline integration.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 同盟的远征分遣队猎捕 [已删改] 残骸，收割核心以供前线整合。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Officially, the AIO runs counterintelligence. Unofficially: R&D, AI trials, and quiet purges.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 官方说法，AIO 负责反情报。非官方：研发、AI 试验，以及安静的清洗。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Athebyne survives on Itoron's food and supplies - a lifeline laced with resentment.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Athebyne 靠 Itoron 的粮食与补给活命——一条掺着怨恨的生命线。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Kori's corrupted nanoforge churns out ships - often flawed, but relentless.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Kori 污染的纳米锻造厂源源不断地产出舰船——常有瑕疵，但从不停歇。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] The former Captain, Emil August's XLII Fleet shattered Athebyne in 72 hours of unrelenting bombardment.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 前舰长 Emil August 的 XLII 舰队用 72 小时不间断的轰炸击碎了 Athebyne。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] August personally executed Athebyne's demagogue aboard a Tri-Tachyon phase ship. No trial was held.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] August 在一艘速子科技相位舰上亲手处决了 Athebyne 的煽动家。没有举行审判。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Itoron's agri-world bounty once fed both planets. Now, it sustains a fragile peace.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Itoron 农业世界的丰饶曾养活两颗行星。如今，它供养着一段脆弱的和平。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Vorium's moons and Athebyne's irradiated quarries fuel Kori's military industry.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Vorium 的卫星与 Athebyne 的辐照采石场，为 Kori 的军事工业供血。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Tri-Tachyon's 'frosty' relations mask deeper ties - scarred by war profiteering, or so the Sector believes.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 速子科技‘冷淡’的关系掩盖着更深的牵连——带着发战争财的旧疤，至少星域这么相信。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Unmarked freighters from the Core Worlds dock at Kori under stellar eclipses. Their manifests? Blank.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 来自核心世界的无标识货轮在星蚀之下停靠 Kori。它们的货单？空白。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Tri-Tachyon data-slates leave Fafnir heavy with 'testbed' prototypes. Plausible deniability thrives in the Rift.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 速子科技的数据板满载着‘测试台’原型离开 Fafnir。合理的推诿在裂隙里枝繁叶茂。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] When Hegemony patrols probe too deep, Tri-Tachyon 'observers' suddenly recall urgent diplomatic relations with the DDA.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] 霸主巡逻队探得太深时，速子科技的‘观察员’会突然想起与 DDA 有紧急外交关系。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Fleet Admiral August rules from a bunker deep within Kori, purging threats real and imagined. Succession? Unspoken.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] August 舰队元帅在 Kori 深处的地堡中统治，清洗着真实与想象的威胁。接班人？无人提起。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] Athebyne's youth drift to the Luddic Path or Ring-Port raiders - old wounds fester in the glow of ruins.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] Athebyne 的年轻人流向卢德左径或环港掠袭者——旧伤在废墟的辉光中溃烂。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: [Draconis] AIO wetwork ensures Tri-Tachyon's 'gifts' stay buried: AI trials, unstable weapons, etc. Desperate to maintain whatever you call Tri-Tachyon's and the DDA's relationship.
zh: [德拉科尼斯] AIO 的湿活确保速子科技的‘礼物’深埋地下：AI 试验、不稳定武器等等。双方拼了命地维持着速子科技与 DDA 之间那随你怎么称呼的关系。
note: 加载界面提示（freq 为权重，勿动）

en: Draconis Loyalist
zh: 德拉科尼斯忠诚派
note: 角色显示名（战斗 chatter 顶部）

en: All stations, this is the Captain. Weapons hot, blood ready. Let's carve our name into their hulls.
zh: 全站注意，舰长广播。武器预热，热血就位。把我们的名字刻进他们的舰壳。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#1）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters! Wake hungry, boys!
zh: 战斗警报，战斗警报！都饿着肚子醒来，小子们！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#2）

en: Power to all batteries. Today the Alliance drinks deep.
zh: 所有炮组供电。今天同盟要痛饮一场。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#3）

en: The ole five-star is watching. Make him proud.
zh: 那位五星上将正看着呢。给他长长脸。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#4）

en: I want their screams on an open channel. Commence firing.
zh: 我要在开放频道里听他们的惨叫。开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#5）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters! All hands man your battle stations! This is not a drill - this is a GIFT.
zh: 战斗警报，战斗警报！全员战斗岗位！这不是演习——这是赏赐。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#6）

en: TAO reports multiple contacts. Finally. Set Condition One throughout the ship - I want every gun hot and every soul hungry.
zh: 战术行动官报告多批目标。可算来了。全舰进入一号战备状态——我要每门炮滚烫，每个灵魂饥饿。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#7）

en: All stations, Captain has the conn. Today we remind the Sector why they fear Draconis.
zh: 全站注意，舰长接管指挥。今天让星域重新想起他们为何惧怕德拉科尼斯。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#8）

en: Combat, Bridge - I have the picture. It's beautiful. Weapons release authority is mine. Let's paint.
zh: 战斗部门，这里是舰桥——态势图在我手里了。真美。武器释放权归我。开始作画。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#9）

en: Tally multiple hostiles. All ahead flank, bring us to knife-fight range - I want to see their faces.
zh: 目视多批敌舰。全速前进，拉进拼刺刀的距离——我要看清他们的脸。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#10）

en: Set EMCON Alpha and run silent. They don't know we're here yet. I want the first salvo to feel like God's fist.
zh: 执行电磁管制阿尔法，静默航行。他们还不知道我们在这儿。我要让第一轮齐射像上帝的铁拳。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#11）

en: Look at the size of that magnificent bastard. Finally, something worth killing!
zh: 瞧瞧那个壮观的大家伙。可算有个值得杀的了！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: That thing thinks it's the apex predator? I'm about to teach it a lesson in pain.
zh: 那玩意儿自以为是顶级掠食者？我这就给它上一堂痛楚课。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: Athebyne was just practice. This is the real sermon. All batteries - crucify it.
zh: Athebyne 只是练习。这才是真正的布道。所有炮组——把它钉上十字架。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: I want its reactor core as a trophy!
zh: 我要把它的反应堆核心当战利品！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: Contact classified CAPITAL. TAO, designate hostile track as Sierra One and paint it for the whole fleet - that kill is MINE.
zh: 目标分类：主力舰。战术行动官，将该敌对航迹编为塞拉一号，给全舰队标出来——那个人头是我的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Now THAT'S a worthy sacrifice to the void. All batteries train on the flagship - I want coordinated fire, maximum rate.
zh: 这才配得上献给虚空的祭品。所有炮组对准旗舰——我要协调火力，最大射速。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: CIC confirms capital-class hostile. Good. I was worried today would be boring. All stations, weapons free on Sierra One.
zh: 作战情报中心确认主力级敌舰。很好。我还担心今天会无聊呢。全站注意，塞拉一号自由开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#7）

en: Tally one big bastard, bearing two-seven-zero. This is what we trained for, people. Press to merge - show them what Fafnir breeds.
zh: 目视一个大块头，方位二七零。这就是我们训练的目的，各位。压上去合流——让他们看看 Fafnir 养出的是什么。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#8）

en: Weapons free! Weapons free! Tear their fucking hearts out!
zh: 自由开火！自由开火！把他们该死的心脏掏出来！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: Batteries released - give me maximum rate, I want them bleeding from every seam!
zh: 炮组解禁——给我最大射速，我要他们每条缝都在流血！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: There we go… smell that? That's fear. Birds away - paint the void with their debris!
zh: 来了……闻到没？那是恐惧。导弹放出去——用他们的碎片涂满虚空！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: You dare fire on US? I'm going to wear your captain's spine as a necklace!
zh: 你敢朝我们开火？我要把他们舰长的脊椎摘下来当项链！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: Ever ask yourself how this part of the sector gets so fucked up all the time?
zh: 你们有没有想过，星域这一角怎么老是搞得这么稀烂？
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: All guns, rapid fire! Make them regret waking up this cycle!
zh: 全炮速射！让他们后悔这个周期醒过来！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Merged! Guns, guns, guns! All batteries, sustained fire - light them up!
zh: 合流了！开炮开炮开炮！所有炮组持续射击——点亮他们！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#7）

en: In the envelope! Weapons free, weapons free! Let them feel Alliance steel!
zh: 进入射程包线！自由开火，自由开火！让他们尝尝同盟的钢！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#8）

en: Contact, contact! Hostile is engaging - GOOD. I was hoping they'd fight back.
zh: 接敌，接敌！敌方开火了——好得很。我还指望他们还手呢。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#9）

en: We're in the merge and I am ALIVE! TAO, continuous fire - don't let them breathe!
zh: 我们在缠斗里，我活着呢！战术行动官，持续射击——别让他们喘气！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#10）

en: Hostile is maneuvering. Cute. Track and engage - show them what cornered prey looks like.
zh: 敌舰在机动。真可爱。跟踪接敌——让他们看看被逼进死角的猎物长什么样。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#11）

en: Birds away, birds away! That's right, RUN from it - it won't help!
zh: 导弹放出，导弹放出！对，跑吧——没用的！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#12）

en: They're shooting back! Finally, someone with spine! All stations, return fire - make it PERSONAL.
zh: 他们还手了！可算有个有骨头的！全站注意，还击——给我往私仇里打。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#13）

en: Roger, engaging. Helm, close the range - I want to see the fear in their viewports.
zh: 收到，接敌。舵机，拉近距离——我要看见他们舷窗里的恐惧。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#14）

en: Tally hostile, twelve o'clock! Fox three, fox three! Swallow THAT, you bastards!
zh: 目视敌舰，十二点方向！导弹放出，导弹放出！咽下去吧，你们这帮杂种！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#15）

en: In the knife fight now! This is where we LIVE, people! Pour it on!
zh: 进拼刺刀的距离了！这就是我们活着的意义，各位！火力全开！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#16）

en: They're running! Chase them down - nobody escapes!
zh: 他们跑了！追上去——一个也别想跑！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: Pursuit course, flank speed! I want to taste their engine wash!
zh: 追击航向，全速！我要尝到他们引擎的尾流！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Run all you want, prey - I haven't had my fun yet!
zh: 随便跑，猎物——我还没玩够呢！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: Close the distance! Ram them if you have to - I want their bridge on my prize!
zh: 拉近距离！必要时撞上去——我要把他们的舰桥挂上我的战利品！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: Contact is bugging out! Negative, you don't get to leave. All ahead flank - run them down!
zh: 目标要溜！不行，你们没资格离开。全速前进——碾过去！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: Hostile is extending. Cute. Helm, pursuit course. I didn't give them permission to die anywhere but here.
zh: 敌舰在拉开距离。真可爱。舵机，追击航向。我可没批准他们死在这儿以外的任何地方。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: No joy on the runner - wait, tally! There you are. Guns, track and fire when in envelope.
zh: 逃逸目标丢失——等等，目视！逮到你了。炮组，跟踪，进包线就开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#7）

en: They think distance will save them. It won't. It just gives me time to savor this.
zh: 他们以为距离能救他们。救不了。那只是给了我细细品味的时间。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#8）

en: Contact retrograde, bearing one-eight-five. TAO, I want a firing solution before they hit the hyper limit. They're not leaving.
zh: 目标后撤，方位一八五。战术行动官，我要在他们越过超空间边界前拿到射击解算。他们走不了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#9）

en: Negative! We do not retreat! …Fine. Tactical withdrawal - but we're coming back to burn their worlds for this.
zh: 否定！我们不撤退！……行吧。战术转移——但我们迟早回来把他们的世界烧成灰。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: Disengaging… I'll remember every single one of you that made me do this.
zh: 脱离接触中……你们每一个逼我这么做的人，我都记住了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: Pulling back. Mark these coordinates. Their gravesite.
zh: 后撤。记下这些坐标。他们的坟场。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: WHO ORDERED THE RETREAT!? ...Fine, breaking contact.
zh: 谁下的撤退令！？……行，脱离接触。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: Breaking contact. This isn't fear - it's me giving them a head start to hell.
zh: 脱离接触。这不是恐惧——这是我给他们先跑一步去地狱的优待。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: All stations, be advised - executing tactical withdrawal. This isn't retreat. This is me deciding when you die.
zh: 全站注意，正在执行战术转移。这不是撤退。这是由我来决定你们什么时候死。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）

en: Bug out, bug out. Break contact and regroup at rally point. I'll remember every one of their faces.
zh: 撤出，撤出。脱离接触，集合点重整。他们每一张脸我都记下了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#7）

en: Going defensive. Helm, get us out of the envelope. We'll be back with friends.
zh: 转入防御。舵机，带我们出射程包线。我们会带着朋友回来的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#8）

en: Retrograde, all units. The math doesn't work today - but it will tomorrow, and I'll collect the debt with interest.
zh: 全军后撤。今天的账算不平——但明天算得平，连本带利我会收回来。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#9）

en: Break, break - all stations disengage. I'm not dying for a bad position. I'm dying for a GLORIOUS one, and this ain't it.
zh: 脱离，脱离——全站脱战。我不会为一个烂阵位去死。我要为一场辉煌的阵位去死，而这里不是。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#10）

en: They scratched us! Ha! That tickles. Return fire tenfold!
zh: 他们刮到我们了！哈！跟挠痒痒似的。十倍还回去！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#1）

en: Minor hit. Good. Now I'm angry.
zh: 轻伤。很好。我现在生气了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#2）

en: Armor penetrated? Cute. Keep shooting - I'm just getting warmed up.
zh: 装甲被穿透？真可爱。继续打——我才刚热身。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#3）

en: A love bite. Give them one back, with interest.
zh: 一个爱的咬痕。还他们一个，带利息的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#4）

en: Damage report: superficial. That tickled. Return fire - show them what a REAL hit looks like.
zh: 损管报告：表皮伤。挠痒痒而已。还击——让他们看看真正的命中长什么样。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#5）

en: Minor hit, forward quarter. Armor integrity holding. Is that the best you've got? Pathetic.
zh: 前象限轻微命中。装甲完整。就这本事？可怜。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#6）

en: DC reports damage negligible. Good. I was starting to think they weren't even trying.
zh: 损管报告损伤可忽略。很好。我都开始以为他们没认真打了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#7）

en: They scratched the paint. TAO, add that ship to the priority queue - I take that personally.
zh: 他们刮花了漆。战术行动官，把那艘船加进优先队列——这事我记仇。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#8）

en: Hull breach sealed, section twelve. Barely felt it. GUNS - make them regret waking up today.
zh: 十二区舰体破口已封。基本没感觉。炮组——让他们后悔今天醒来。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#9）

en: Half hull left? Perfect - less weight, more rage. Press the attack!
zh: 还剩半边船体？完美——更轻，更疯。继续进攻！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#1）

en: We're bleeding… good. Blood makes the deck slippery for boarding parties.
zh: 我们在流血……很好。血会让甲板变滑，方便跳帮的弟兄。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#2）

en: Fifty percent? That's still fifty percent more than they're going to have in a minute!
zh: 百分之五十？那也比他们一分钟后剩下的多百分之五十！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#3）

en: Plug the holes! We're pushing the attack!
zh: 堵住破口！我们继续进攻！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#4）

en: Damage control - patch it with enemy wreckage if you have to. We are NOT slowing down!
zh: 损管——拿敌方残骸堵也行。我们绝不减速！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#5）

en: Fifty percent hull. We're bleeding, but so are they. Damage control, keep her fighting - we're not done yet.
zh: 船体百分之五十。我们在流血，但他们也是。损管，让她接着打——我们还没完。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#6）

en: Material condition degraded but combat-effective. Pain is just the void's way of saying hello. Press the attack!
zh: 结构状态下降但保有战斗力。疼痛只是虚空打招呼的方式。继续进攻！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#7）

en: Heavy damage amidships. Multiple casualties. Their mistake - now my crew has something personal to fight for.
zh: 舰体中部重创。多人伤亡。他们的失误——现在我的船员有私仇要报了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#8）

en: DC teams, maximum effort! I don't care if you're holding the bulkhead together with your bare hands - this ship FIGHTS.
zh: 损管队，全力上！我不管你们是不是在用光着手撑着舱壁——这艘船要战斗。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#9）

en: We've taken hits. Good. Bleeding makes the victory sweeter. All stations maintain fire!
zh: 我们挨了几发。很好。流血让胜利更甜。全站保持火力！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#10）

en: CIC's half-dark and I can smell burning. Perfect. Now we fight like our ancestors - angry and cornered.
zh: 作战情报中心灭了一半灯，我闻到糊味了。完美。现在我们像祖先一样战斗——愤怒，且被逼入绝境。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#11）

en: Hull critical! Excellent! Now we fight like cornered gods!
zh: 船体危急！好极了！现在我们像被逼入死角的神一样战斗！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#1）

en: She's dying - so let's take the whole damn fleet with us!
zh: 她要死了——那就把这一整支该死的舰队都带上！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#2）

en: Thirty percent? That's thirty percent more than enough to ram their bridge!
zh: 百分之三十？撞他们舰桥都还多出百分之三十！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#3）

en: Reactor's singing the death song - I love this part! All power to forward guns!
zh: 反应堆开始唱死亡之歌——我爱这一段！全部功率给前主炮！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#4）

en: Kill me, Kill me, KILL ME! - Put your fucking gun in my mouth and pull the fucking trigger!
zh: 杀了我，杀了我，杀了我！——把你那该死的枪塞进我嘴里，扣动那该死的扳机！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#5）

en: Hull critical! All hands, this is the Captain - we're dying, so let's take the whole damn fleet with us!
zh: 船体危急！全体注意，我是舰长——我们要死了，那就把这一整支该死的舰队都带上！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#6）

en: Thirty percent and falling. Outstanding. RAMMING SPEED - if I'm meeting the void, I'm bringing company!
zh: 百分之三十还在掉。好极了。撞击航速——既然要去见虚空，我就带几个作伴的！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#7）

en: Catastrophic damage! DC, abandon your stations and man the guns - we're past saving, but they aren't past killing!
zh: 灾难性损伤！损管，放弃岗位，全都上炮——我们没救了，但他们还没杀够！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#8）

en: She's breaking apart beneath me and I've never felt more alive! All power to forward batteries!
zh: 她在我脚下解体，而我从没感觉如此活着！全部功率给前炮组！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#9）

en: Reactor warning, hull failing - THIS IS WHERE LEGENDS ARE MADE! All hands, maximum rate of fire until she splits!
zh: 反应堆告警，船体衰竭——传奇就是在这里铸成的！全员注意，最大射速打到她裂开为止！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#10）

en: We're dead already. The only question is how many we drag down with us. MAKE IT COUNT!
zh: 我们已经死了。唯一的问题是能拖多少垫背的。别浪费！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#11）

en: All Alliance ships this net - get in here and taste this glory with me!
zh: 网络内所有同盟舰船——过来，跟我一起尝尝这份荣光！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#1）

en: I need more wolves on this kill! Vector to my position now!
zh: 这场猎杀我需要更多狼！立刻向我的位置机动！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#2）

en: Brothers, the feast is ready - come claim your share!
zh: 弟兄们，宴席已备好——来取你们那一份！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#3）

en: Where's my pack? This prey is too big for one set of jaws!
zh: 我的狼群呢？这猎物一张嘴可咬不动！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#4）

en: Any Alliance unit this net, this is $shipNameNoPrefix - I've got a target-rich environment and I'm running out of hull. Get over here and share the glory!
zh: 网络内任意同盟单位，这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix——目标多到打不完，船体快不够用了。过来分享荣光！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#5）

en: Request immediate support, my position! Not because I need saving - because there's too much killing for one ship!
zh: 请求立即支援，我的位置！不是因为需要救命——是因为一艘船杀不过来！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#6）

en: All stations, $shipNameNoPrefix is heavily engaged. I'm having the time of my life, but I could use more guns on this party!
zh: 全站注意，$shipNameNoPrefix 陷入重围。我这辈子没这么爽过，但这场派对还缺几门炮！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#7）

en: Flash traffic - require assistance! These bastards think they've got me cornered. Prove them right, then prove them DEAD.
zh: 急电——请求支援！这帮杂种以为把我逼进死角了。先让他们以为对了，再让他们死透。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#8）

en: Brothers, sisters - vector to my beacon! The hunt is good here and I need more wolves!
zh: 弟兄们，姊妹们——向我的信标机动！这边的猎场很好，我需要更多狼！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#9）

en: All units - this fight is beneath us now. Withdraw. We'll hunt them another day.
zh: 全体注意——这场仗已经配不上我们了。撤出。改日再猎。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#1）

en: Break off. I want them alive… so I can kill them slowly next time.
zh: 脱离。我要他们活着……好下次慢慢杀。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#2）

en: Tactical withdrawal. Let them think they've won. The reckoning will be beautiful.
zh: 战术转移。让他们以为赢了。清算之日会很美。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#3）

en: Pulling out. Save your ammo - we're coming back with friends.
zh: 撤出。省着弹药——我们会带着朋友回来的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#4）

en: All units, this is $shipNameNoPrefix - disengage and withdraw to rally point. We're not running. We're reloading.
zh: 全体单位，这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix——脱战，撤往集合点。我们不是在逃跑。我们是在换弹。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#5）

en: Break contact on my mark. Mark. Let them think they've won - the look on their faces when we come back will be worth it.
zh: 听我口令脱离。脱。让他们以为赢了——等我们回来时他们脸上的表情，值了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#6）

en: Bug out, all ships. Preserve your hulls and your hatred. We'll need both tomorrow.
zh: 全体撤出。保住你们的船体和仇恨。明天两样都要用。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#7）

en: Fleet withdrawal, execute. I want every captain to memorize their faces. This isn't over - it's intermission.
zh: 舰队撤退，执行。我要每位舰长记熟他们的脸。这事没完——只是中场休息。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#8）

en: All stations RTB. Ammunition and vengeance need resupply. We'll be back.
zh: 全站返回基地。弹药和复仇都需要补给。我们会回来的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#9）

en: VLS dry. Fine. Time to get intimate. All ahead full - ramming speed!
zh: 发射井空了。很好。到贴身肉搏的时候了。全速前进——撞击航速！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#1）

en: Missiles gone? Good. Now we use the guns like men.
zh: 导弹打光了？很好。现在我们像男人一样用炮说话。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#2）

en: Out of birds. Switch to main batteries - I want to see their faces when we gut them.
zh: 导弹没了。转主炮组——我要看着他们的脸被我们开膛。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#3）

en: No more missiles? Then we do this the old way - teeth and fury.
zh: 没导弹了？那就按老规矩来——牙齿和怒火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#4）

en: Winchester on all missile systems. Outstanding - now we close to gun range like REAL sailors!
zh: 全部导弹系统耗尽。好极了——现在我们像真正的水兵一样拉进炮距！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#5）

en: VLS reports empty. TAO, shift to guns. I wanted to get personal anyway.
zh: 发射井报告清空。战术行动官，转炮战。反正我早就想动手动脚了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#6）

en: Missiles expended, switching to kinetics. This is the part I've been waiting for.
zh: 导弹耗尽，转动能武器。这才是我一直等的环节。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#7）

en: Winchester, winchester. No more birds. Helm, all ahead flank - we're doing this with teeth and tungsten.
zh: 耗尽，耗尽。没弹了。舵机，全速前进——用牙齿和钨钢解决。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#8）

en: Out of smart weapons. Time for dumb violence. Close the range!
zh: 智能武器打光了。到野蛮暴力登场的时间了。拉近距离！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#9）

en: Flux critical! Beautiful! Vent it - let them see our war-face!
zh: 幅能危急！漂亮！排掉——让他们看看我们的战争面孔！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#1）

en: Overload cascade - yes! Ride the lightning, you glorious bastards!
zh: 过载连锁——好！驾驭闪电吧，你们这群光辉的杂种！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#2）

en: Capacitors screaming! That's the sound of the Alliance ascending!
zh: 电容在尖叫！那是同盟正在飞升的声音！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#3）

en: Forced vent! Watch them flinch when we come out the other side burning!
zh: 强制排幅！看我们从火光里冲出来时他们缩成什么样！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#4）

en: Flux critical! Emergency vent in three - two - one - WATCH THEM FLINCH!
zh: 幅能危急！紧急排幅，三——二——一——看他们缩头！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#5）

en: Capacitors redlined! Dropping shields to vent - and we're coming out of this hotter than we went in!
zh: 电容红区！弃盾排幅——我们从另一头出来时，会比进去时更烫！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#6）

en: Overload cascade! Engineering, ride it! Ride it like a war hymn!
zh: 过载连锁！轮机部门，驾驭它！像驾驭战歌一样驾驭它！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#7）

en: Going defensive - forced vent! The ship's screaming and so am I! This is BEAUTIFUL!
zh: 转入防御——强制排幅！船在尖叫，我也在尖叫！这太美了！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#8）

en: Flux spike! Venting hard! Anyone who fires on us during this is going to regret it for the rest of their very short life!
zh: 幅能尖峰！全力排幅！谁敢趁现在朝我们开火，就用他剩下不长的命去后悔吧！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#9）

en: Reactor breach… ha… tell August… I died… THRIVING…
zh: 反应堆破裂……哈……告诉 August……我死的时候……风头正劲……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#1）

en: She's going up… taking half the sector with me… worth it…
zh: 她要炸了……拉半个星域陪葬……值了……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#2）

en: This is the Captain… going to meet the enemy in hell… save me a seat at their table…
zh: 这里是舰长……去地狱会一会敌人……给我在他们那桌留个座……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#3）

en: Core critical… glory… to the Alliance… glory… to me…
zh: 核心危急……荣光……归于同盟……荣光……归于我……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#4）

en: If I die… I die the apex predator… see you in the void…
zh: 若我死……也要死成顶级掠食者……虚空见……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#5）

en: Core breach... reactor critical... all hands, it's been an honor... NOW WATCH ME BURN LIKE A STAR...
zh: 核心破裂……反应堆危急……全体官兵，与有荣焉……现在看我像恒星一样燃烧……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#6）

en: She's going up... tell August... tell him I died... with my finger on the trigger...
zh: 她要炸了……告诉 August……告诉他，我死的时候……手指还扣在扳机上……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#7）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix... we are... lost... but we took... so many with us...
zh: 这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix……我们……完了……但我们带走了……太多太多……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#8）

en: Abandon ship... abandon... no. NO. All hands stay at your guns... we fire until the void takes us...
zh: 弃船……弃……不。不。全员坚守炮位……打到虚空把我们收走为止……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#9）

en: Reactor scram failed... this is it... glory to the Alliance... glory to the HUNT...
zh: 反应堆急停失败……就到这里了……荣光归于同盟……荣光归于狩猎……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#10）

en: Breaking up... I can see the stars through the hull... beautiful... see you in hell, you bastards... save me a seat...
zh: 解体中……我能透过舰壳看见星星……真美……地狱见，你们这帮杂种……给我留个座……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#11）

en: All contacts neutralized. The void is ours. I am pleased.
zh: 全部目标已清除。虚空属于我们。我很满意。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#1）

en: They're dead. I'm not. Another perfect day.
zh: 他们死了。我没有。又一个完美的日子。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#2）

en: Enemy scrapped. Someone mount their bridge on my ready room bulkhead.
zh: 敌人报废。谁把他们的舰桥拆下来，挂到我待命室的舱壁上。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#3）

en: Field clear. Our legend grows - and I'm still hungry.
zh: 战场清空。传说又长了一寸——而我还饿着。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#4）

en: Victory. Fafnir, your blade sings true through us.
zh: 胜利。法夫纳，你的刀刃借我们唱得正响。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#5）

en: All contacts splashed. Battlespace sanitized. I need a cigarette and a new target list.
zh: 全部目标击落。战场消毒完毕。我需要一支烟和一份新目标清单。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#6）

en: Secure from General Quarters. That was... adequate. Find me something harder next time.
zh: 解除战斗警报。刚才那场……勉强合格。下次给我找个更硬的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#7）

en: Hostile force neutralized. Tally the kills - I want names and tonnage for the ready room wall.
zh: 敌军已消灭。清点战果——我要名字和吨位，刻上待命室的墙。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#8）

en: Area clear. We're still breathing, they're not. Another successful sermon. Always Above.
zh: 区域清空。我们还在喘气，他们不用了。又一场成功的布道。永居其上。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#9）

en: Combat complete. All stations, damage and ammo report - we're not done until I say we're done.
zh: 战斗结束。全站注意，上报损伤与弹药——我说没完，就没完。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#10）

en: Threats eliminated. Someone crack open the good stuff - the void drank deep today, and so shall we.
zh: 威胁清除。谁去把好酒开了——今天虚空喝了个饱，我们也该喝个饱。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#11）

en: The beast is dead! I have its heart! The Alliance will feast tonight!
zh: 巨兽死了！它的心脏在我手里！同盟今夜设宴！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#1）

en: Major target destroyed. Tell the Admiral his favorite mad dog just bagged a dragon.
zh: 主要目标摧毁。告诉元帅，他最爱的疯狗刚猎了一条龙。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#2）

en: It's down, bleeding, broken - by my hand. The galaxy will speak my name in fear.
zh: 它倒了，流着血，碎成块——出自我的手。银河将带着恐惧念我的名字。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#3）

en: Look upon your killer, corpse. The Alliance has spoken - and the void itself kneels.
zh: 看着你的杀手吧，尸体。同盟已经裁决——连虚空本身都要下跪。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#4）

en: Capital ship SPLASHED! Sierra One is debris! Log that kill - flag-grade, personal, MINE.
zh: 主力舰击落！塞拉一号已成碎片！记下这笔战果——将官级，个人，我的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#5）

en: High-value target destroyed. That's a trophy kill, people. Fleet's gonna hear about this one.
zh: 高价值目标摧毁。这是战利品级的猎杀，各位。全舰队都会听说这一仗。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#6）

en: The beast is dead by Alliance hands. TAO, confirm the kill and broadcast it wide - let the Sector know.
zh: 巨兽死于同盟之手。战术行动官，确认战果并广而播之——让全星域知道。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#7）

en: Flagship down! That's what happens when you face ME! Mark coordinates for salvage - I want a piece of that hull on my wall.
zh: 旗舰击落！跟我对上的下场就是这样！标记坐标准备打捞——我要一块舰壳挂墙上。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#8）

en: Primary target eliminated. They sent their best and we turned it into scrap. Today was a GOOD day.
zh: 首要目标消灭。他们派出了最强者，我们把它变成了废铁。今天是很好的一天。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#9）

en: Draconis Officer
zh: 德拉科尼斯军官
note: 角色显示名（战斗 chatter 顶部）

en: All stations, this is the Captain. Set General Quarters. Commence combat operations.
zh: 全站注意，这里是舰长。进入战斗警报。开始作战行动。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#1）

en: TAO reports weapons hot, systems green. Ready to engage on your order.
zh: 战术行动官报告武器就绪，系统全绿。等待命令即可接敌。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#2）

en: Battle stations manned and ready. Standing by for weapons release.
zh: 战斗岗位就位完毕。等待武器释放。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#3）

en: Ship is at General Quarters, combat systems fully operational. Awaiting your command.
zh: 全舰进入战斗警报，作战系统全面运转。等待命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#4）

en: All stations report ready for action. Combat watch closed up.
zh: 全站报告可战。战斗值更已就位。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#5）

en: All stations, Actual. Set condition one throughout the ship. This is not a drill.
zh: 全站注意，舰长本人在此。全舰进入一号战备状态。这不是演习。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#6）

en: TAO, Captain. I have the conn. Weapons posture to free, safeties off.
zh: 战术行动官，我是舰长。我接管指挥。武器状态转自由，解除保险。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#7）

en: Combat, Bridge. Confirm hostile intent and stand by for weapons release.
zh: 战斗部门，舰桥。确认敌方意图，待命武器释放。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#8）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters. All hands man your battle stations.
zh: 战斗警报，战斗警报。全员战斗岗位。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#9）

en: We have tasking. Spin up all systems and stand by for further.
zh: 收到任务。启动全部系统，待命后续指令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#10）

en: Contacts flagged hostile per ROE. Proceeding as briefed.
zh: 按交战规则标记目标为敌对。按简报执行。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#11）

en: All stations report manned and ready. Authenticate and stand by.
zh: 全站报告就位。完成鉴权，待命。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#12）

en: Bridge has tactical authority. Weapons tight until my command.
zh: 舰桥持有战术权限。武器管制，听我命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#13）

en: High-value target designated ALPHA. All weapons train on that contact. Priority engagement.
zh: 高价值目标编为阿尔法。全部武器对准该目标。优先接敌。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: Capital ship contact bearing, classified high-threat. Weapons tight until PID confirmed.
zh: 主力舰级目标，入向方位，分类高威胁。身份确认前武器管制。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: Flag-level hostile confirmed. Bringing the full broadside to bear.
zh: 将官级敌舰确认。全舷侧对准目标。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: That's the primary threat. All batteries, this is our fight.
zh: 那是首要威胁。所有炮组，这一仗是我们的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: TAO, designate that contact ALPHA-ONE. All stations, this is a priority tasking.
zh: 战术行动官，该目标编为阿尔法一号。全站注意，这是优先任务。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Confirm visual on high-value target. Weapons free on ALPHA, acknowledge.
zh: 确认目视高价值目标。阿尔法自由开火，收到请回话。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: That signature matches our briefing. Someone upstairs wants this one gone.
zh: 特征与简报吻合。上面有人想让这一个消失。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#7）

en: Capital-class hostile, positively identified. We have authorization to prosecute.
zh: 主力级敌舰，身份确认。我们已获准接战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#8）

en: All stations, be advised - this target is flagged at the directorate level. No mistakes.
zh: 全站注意，该目标已标记至理事会级。不许出错。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#9）

en: HVT on scope. Adjust firing solutions, I want overlapping coverage on that hull.
zh: 高价值目标入镜。调整射击解算，我要对该舰体的交叉覆盖。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#10）

en: Weapons free, weapons free. Engaging hostile contacts.
zh: 自由开火，自由开火。接敌交战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: Batteries released. Commence fire, commence fire.
zh: 炮组解禁。开火，开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: Target locked. Birds away.
zh: 目标锁定。导弹放出。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: Range closing. Opening fire with all available weapons.
zh: 距离拉近。以全部可用武器开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: Positive ID, hostile. You are cleared hot. Shoot.
zh: 身份确认，敌对。准许开火。射击。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: All stations, we are engaged. Weapons free, I say again, weapons free.
zh: 全站注意，已接敌。自由开火，重复，自由开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Fox three, fox three. Missiles away, tracking true.
zh: 导弹放出，导弹放出。导弹离架，追踪正常。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#7）

en: TAO, shift fire to the next contact. Keep the pressure on.
zh: 战术行动官，火力转移至下一目标。保持压力。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#8）

en: Guns, guns, guns. Kinetics on target.
zh: 开炮开炮开炮。动能弹药上靶。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#9）

en: Contact the bearing, engaged. Splash when able.
zh: 方位接敌，已交战。有机会就击落。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#10）

en: Copy, hostile is maneuvering. Maintain solution and continue to prosecute.
zh: 收到，敌舰机动中。保持解算，继续接战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#11）

en: Firing for effect. Report impacts as observed.
zh: 效力射。观测弹着并上报。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#12）

en: We have a good track. Continue engagement until otherwise directed.
zh: 跟踪良好。继续交战，另候指示。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#13）

en: Keep it professional. Shoot what you can hit, hit what you shoot.
zh: 保持专业。打得中的才打，打了就要中。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#14）

en: Tally, bandits. Engaging the near contact first.
zh: 目视敌机。先打近目标。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#15）

en: Target is running. Pursuing at flank speed, maintain firing solution.
zh: 目标逃跑。全速追击，保持射击解算。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: Hostile attempting to break contact. Negative, closing to knife-fight range.
zh: 敌舰试图脱离接触。否定，拉进拼刺刀距离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Pursuit course. Do not let them disengage.
zh: 追击航向。别让他们脱战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: They're turning away. Press the attack, keep them in the envelope.
zh: 他们在转向脱离。压上攻击，别让他们出包线。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: Contact is retrograde. Increase speed, do not let them clear the battlespace.
zh: 目标后撤。提速，别让他们清出战场。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: TAO, they're running. Pursue and prosecute until otherwise directed.
zh: 战术行动官，他们跑了。追击接战，另候指示。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: Helm, all ahead flank. We have authorization to chase this one down.
zh: 舵机，全速前进。我们获准追杀这一个。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#7）

en: Hostile is attempting to break contact. Negative. Maintain pursuit.
zh: 敌舰试图脱离接触。否定。保持追击。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#8）

en: They want out. That's not in our tasking. Close the distance.
zh: 他们想走。任务里没这条。拉近距离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#9）

en: Stay on them. Someone wants gun camera footage of this one burning.
zh: 咬住他们。上面有人想要它烧起来的炮口录像。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#10）

en: Do not lose that contact. We were told to make this thorough.
zh: 别丢目标。上头交代过要把这事办彻底。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#11）

en: Executing tactical withdrawal. Screening units cover our pullout.
zh: 执行战术转移。警戒单元掩护我们撤出。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: Combat effectiveness reduced. Disengaging per doctrine.
zh: 战斗效能下降。按教义脱离接触。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: We're taking heavy fire. Break contact, reform at rally point.
zh: 我们火力承压严重。脱离接触，集合点重整。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: Captain orders tactical retrograde. All units acknowledge withdrawal.
zh: 舰长下令战术后撤。全体确认撤退。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: All stations, break contact. Execute withdrawal to designated rally point.
zh: 全站注意，脱离接触。撤往指定集合点。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: Tactical situation has deteriorated. Recommend immediate disengagement.
zh: 战术态势恶化。建议立即脱离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）

en: This engagement is no longer within acceptable parameters. Pull out.
zh: 本次交战已超出可接受参数。撤出。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#7）

en: Helm, come about. We're preserving the asset for another day.
zh: 舵机，转向。我们为改日保全这件资产。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#8）

en: Command has been advised of our situation. Disengaging now.
zh: 司令部已知晓我方态势。现在脱离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#9）

en: We'll get another shot. Disengage and regroup.
zh: 还有下一次机会。脱离重整。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#10）

en: This one isn't worth the hull. All stations, break off.
zh: 这个目标不值这条船。全站注意，脱离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#11）

en: Minor hull hit, port quarter. Damage negligible, continuing the engagement.
zh: 左舷尾部轻微中弹。损伤可忽略，继续交战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#1）

en: Took a round, armor held. No impact on combat capability.
zh: 挨了一发，装甲顶住。不影响战斗能力。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#2）

en: Light damage forward. DC parties respond, maintain fire.
zh: 前部轻损。损管组处置，保持火力。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#3）

en: Hit confirmed, superficial. Weapons and propulsion nominal.
zh: 命中确认，表皮伤。武器与推进正常。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#4）

en: Damage control, minor hit starboard side. Assess and report.
zh: 损管，右舷轻微命中。评估并上报。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#5）

en: That one grazed us. All stations, maintain current operations.
zh: 那发擦过我们。全站维持当前作业。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#6）

en: Armor took the brunt. Ship remains combat effective.
zh: 装甲吃下了大头。舰船保有战斗力。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#7）

en: Negligible damage. Continue the mission.
zh: 损伤可忽略。继续任务。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#8）

en: We're scratched, not stopped. Keep firing.
zh: 我们挂了彩，没停下。继续开火。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#9）

en: Light contact, no casualties. Press the attack.
zh: 轻度接触，无伤亡。继续进攻。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_90#10）

en: Hull integrity fifty percent. We're hurt but still in the fight.
zh: 舰体完整度百分之五十。我们伤了，但还在局里。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#1）

en: Multiple hits amidships. Damage control, prioritize magazines and VLS.
zh: 舰体中部多次中弹。损管，优先弹药库与发射井。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#2）

en: Heavy damage. Requesting screening support to remain engaged.
zh: 重损。请求警戒支援以维持接战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#3）

en: Fifty percent structure remaining. Guns still answering bells.
zh: 结构剩余百分之五十。炮组仍在应答指令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#4）

en: Significant structural damage. Continuing offensive operations.
zh: 结构损伤严重。继续进攻作业。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#5）

en: Damage control, multiple compartments reporting flooding. Contain it.
zh: 损管，多舱室报告进水。控制住。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#6）

en: We've lost redundancy in several systems. Rerouting through backups.
zh: 多系统冗余丢失。改走备份线路。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#7）

en: TAO, report combat effectiveness... Copy, we're still in this.
zh: 战术行动官，上报战斗效能……收到，我们还在局里。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#8）

en: Hull's compromised but the mission isn't. Continue engagement.
zh: 舰体破防了，任务没有。继续交战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#9）

en: Took heavy hits. Adjusting posture to compensate.
zh: 挨了重击。调整姿态补偿。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#10）

en: Command is aware of our status. Proceed until otherwise directed.
zh: 司令部知晓我方状态。继续执行，另候指示。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#11）

en: She's hurt. We've worked with worse.
zh: 她伤了。更糟的我们都打过。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_50#12）

en: Critical hull damage! Multiple frames failing. Prepare to abandon ship if ordered!
zh: 船体危急损伤！多处骨架失效！准备听令弃船！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#1）

en: Losing integrity fast! All damage control parties, maximum effort!
zh: 完整度急速流失！全体损管组，全力抢修！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#2）

en: Hull failing in multiple sections! Brace for impact, brace!
zh: 多区段舰体衰竭！准备撞击，稳住！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#3）

en: We're coming apart! All hands to escape pods, stand by!
zh: 我们在解体！全员前往逃生舱，待命！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#4）

en: Hull failing - We're coming apart! Be ready to abandon ship!
zh: 舰体衰竭——我们在解体！准备弃船！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#5）

en: All stations, this is not a drill. Prepare for possible abandonment.
zh: 全站注意，这不是演习。准备必要时弃船。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#6）

en: Structural failure imminent. DC, give me everything you've got.
zh: 结构损毁迫在眉睫。损管，把你有的都给我。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#7）

en: We are in extremis. All hands, stand by for further orders.
zh: 我们濒临绝境。全体待命，等候进一步命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#8）

en: She's breaking up. Stay calm, stay professional. We've trained for this.
zh: 她在解体。保持镇定，保持专业。我们练过这个。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#9）

en: Multiple critical failures. Begin emergency protocols, await my command.
zh: 多处危急失效。启动应急规程，等我命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#10）

en: Catastrophic damage sustained. Maintain stations until ordered otherwise.
zh: 承受灾难性损伤。坚守岗位，另候命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#11）

en: This is the Captain. Stay at your posts. We're not done yet.
zh: 这里是舰长。坚守岗位。我们还没完。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 hull_30#12）

en: Any unit this net, this is $shipNameNoPrefix, heavily engaged, multiple hostiles, require immediate assistance.
zh: 网络内任意单位，这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix，陷入重围，多批敌舰，请求立即援助。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#1）

en: Taking heavy fire from multiple vectors. Request relief force now.
zh: 多向量重火来袭。请求增援，立刻。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#2）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix, under concentrated fire, need support at this time.
zh: 这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix，遭集中火力，现在就需要支援。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#3）

en: We are in contact, outnumbered. Any friendly unit, vector to my position.
zh: 已接敌，寡不敌众。任意友军单位，向我位置机动。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#4）

en: Any Alliance unit this net, request immediate fire support at my position.
zh: 网络内任意同盟单位，请求我位置的即时火力支援。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#5）

en: We are engaged and require backup. Acknowledge and vector.
zh: 我们已接敌并需要后援。收到后请机动。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#6）

en: Multiple contacts, single ship. Requesting any available asset.
zh: 多批目标，单舰应对。请求一切可用资产。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#7）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix. We need support or we're not making it out.
zh: 这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix。没有支援我们出不去了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#8）

en: Priority request - any friendly unit, we are combat ineffective without support.
zh: 优先请求——任意友军单位，没有支援我们将丧失战斗能力。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#9）

en: Going defensive. Request immediate assistance from any station.
zh: 转入防御。请求任意站台立即援助。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 need_help#10）

en: All units, execute immediate withdrawal to phase line Delta. Acknowledge.
zh: 全体单位，立即撤往三角洲相位线。收到请回话。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#1）

en: Break contact. Tactical withdrawal, cover each other.
zh: 脱离接触。战术转移，互相掩护。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#2）

en: Fleet order: disengage and reform. Cease fire, maximize distance.
zh: 舰队命令：脱战重整。停火，拉开距离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#3）

en: We're pulling out. Screen the withdrawal, then follow.
zh: 我们撤出。掩护撤退，然后跟上。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#4）

en: All stations this net, disengage and proceed to rally point. Acknowledge.
zh: 网络内全站注意，脱战并前往集合点。收到请回话。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#5）

en: Cease fire, cease fire. Execute tactical withdrawal on my mark.
zh: 停火，停火。听我口令执行战术转移。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#6）

en: This engagement is terminated. All units RTB.
zh: 本次交战终止。全体返回基地。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#7）

en: Command has authorized withdrawal. Break contact and regroup.
zh: 司令部已批准撤退。脱离接触，重整。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#8）

en: We've done what we can here. Preserve your ships.
zh: 这里我们能做的都做了。保全你们的船。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#9）

en: Disengage by sections. Screen each other on the way out.
zh: 分批脱离。出去的路上互相掩护。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 retreat#10）

en: VLS cells empty. Switching to five-inch and energy batteries.
zh: 发射井清空。转五英寸炮与能量炮组。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#1）

en: Missile expenditure complete. Continuing with guns, close the range.
zh: 导弹耗尽。继续用炮，拉近距离。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#2）

en: Ordnance expended. Transitioning to gun engagement.
zh: 弹药耗尽。转入炮战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#3）

en: No missiles remaining. Going to knives.
zh: 导弹耗尽。上刺刀。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#4）

en: TAO reports Winchester on all missile systems. Guns only.
zh: 战术行动官报告全部导弹系统耗尽。只用炮。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#5）

en: All tubes dry. Shifting to direct fire weapons.
zh: 全部发射管空了。转直射武器。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#6）

en: Missile loadout expended. Close to gun range.
zh: 导弹装载耗尽。拉进炮距。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#7）

en: We're Winchester. Someone make a note for the debrief.
zh: 我们弹尽。谁在复盘会上记一笔。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#8）

en: Out of birds. Continue prosecution with available weapons.
zh: 没弹了。用现有武器继续接战。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#9）

en: VLS shows empty across the board. Guns will have to do.
zh: 发射井全空。只能靠炮了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 out_of_missiles#10）

en: Flux critical! Emergency vent - weapons temporarily offline!
zh: 幅能危急！紧急排幅——武器暂时离线！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#1）

en: Overload cascade! Forced vent in three… two…
zh: 过载连锁！强制排幅，三……二……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#2）

en: Capacitors spiking - dropping shields to vent!
zh: 电容尖峰——弃盾排幅！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#3）

en: Flux overload! All hands brace for vent!
zh: 幅能过载！全体稳住，准备排幅！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#4）

en: Engineering reports flux critical. Venting now.
zh: 轮机报告幅能危急。现在排幅。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#5）

en: All stations, brace for emergency vent. Shields cycling.
zh: 全站注意，稳住准备紧急排幅。护盾循环中。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#6）

en: Capacitor overload. We'll be dark for a moment, stay calm.
zh: 电容过载。我们会黑一小会儿，保持镇定。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#7）

en: Flux grid at capacity. Forced vent in progress.
zh: 幅能电网满载。强制排幅进行中。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#8）

en: Going defensive while we vent. Helm, evasive.
zh: 排幅期间转入防御。舵机，规避。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#9）

en: Thermal spike across the grid. Emergency protocols initiated.
zh: 电网全面热尖峰。应急规程已启动。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 overload#10）

en: Reactor criticality… abandon ship… abandon ship…
zh: 反应堆临界……弃船……弃船……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#1）

en: She's breaking up… give 'em hell for us…
zh: 她在解体……替我们给他们点颜色……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#2）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix… we are lost… avenge us…
zh: 这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix……我们完了……为我们复仇……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#3）

en: Core breach… it's been an honor serving with you…
zh: 核心破裂……与各位共役，荣幸之至……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#4）

en: Catastrophic damage! Reactor scram, abandon ship, abandon ship!
zh: 灾难性损伤！反应堆急停，弃船，弃船！
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#5）

en: Mayday, mayday… $shipNameNoPrefix is sinking…
zh: 求救，求救……$shipNameNoPrefix 正在沉没……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#6）

en: All hands, abandon ship. Abandon ship. This is the Captain... it's been an honor.
zh: 全体弃船。弃船。这里是舰长……与有荣焉。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#7）

en: Reactor containment failure. May God have mercy... abandon ship.
zh: 反应堆约束失效。愿神怜悯……弃船。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#8）

en: Core breach imminent. Get to the pods. That's an order.
zh: 核心破裂在即。上逃生舱。这是命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#9）

en: $shipNameNoPrefix, final transmission. Tell the Office... mission complete.
zh: $shipNameNoPrefix，最终通讯。告诉情报局……任务完成。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#10）

en: She's gone. All hands, get clear... get clear...
zh: 她没了。全体，离远点……离远点……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#11）

en: This is $shipNameNoPrefix... we did our duty... signing off...
zh: 这里是 $shipNameNoPrefix……我们尽了职……通讯结束……
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 death#12）

en: All contacts neutralized. Area secured.
zh: 全部目标已清除。区域安全。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#1）

en: Threats eliminated. Good work, crew.
zh: 威胁消除。干得好，各位。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#2）

en: Hostiles destroyed. Secure from general quarters.
zh: 敌军摧毁。解除战斗警报。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#3）

en: Battlespace is ours. Standing by for further orders.
zh: 战场归我们所有。待命后续命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#4）

en: Enemy force neutralized. Resume patrol posture.
zh: 敌军消灭。恢复巡逻姿态。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#5）

en: All contacts splashed. Secure from General Quarters.
zh: 全部目标击落。解除战斗警报。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#6）

en: TAO confirms battlespace clear. Good shooting, everyone.
zh: 战术行动官确认战场清空。打得好，各位。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#7）

en: Hostile force eliminated. Resume standard operations.
zh: 敌军消灭。恢复标准作业。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#8）

en: Tasking complete. Standing by for follow-on orders.
zh: 任务完成。待命后续命令。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#9）

en: Mission accomplished. The Office will be pleased.
zh: 任务达成。情报局会满意的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#10）

en: Area sanitized. Proceeding to next objective.
zh: 区域肃清。前往下一目标。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#11）

en: That's the last of them. Log it and move on.
zh: 那是最后一批。记录在案，继续前进。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory#12）

en: High-value target destroyed. Major objective complete.
zh: 高价值目标摧毁。主要目标完成。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#1）

en: Capital ship kill confirmed. Damn fine shooting.
zh: 主力舰击杀确认。打得真漂亮。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#2）

en: Primary threat eliminated. Log that one for the wardroom tonight.
zh: 首要威胁消灭。这笔今晚写进军官餐厅的记录。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#3）

en: Flag-level hostile sunk. The fleet owes this crew.
zh: 将官级敌舰击沉。舰队欠这班人一个人情。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#4）

en: ALPHA is down. Confirming kill on the high-value target.
zh: 阿尔法倒下。确认高价值目标击杀。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#5）

en: HVT destroyed. Someone upstairs is going to be very happy.
zh: 高价值目标摧毁。上面某个人要非常高兴了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#6）

en: Primary objective eliminated. I want gun camera footage preserved.
zh: 主要目标消灭。炮口录像要保存好。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#7）

en: Splash one capital. That's one for the directorate's wall.
zh: 击落主力舰一艘。这是能上理事会墙的一笔。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#8）

en: Target neutralized as directed. Excellent work, all stations.
zh: 目标已按指示瘫痪。出色的工作，各站。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#9）

en: The briefing said this one mattered. Now it doesn't. Well done.
zh: 简报里说这一个要紧。现在不要紧了。干得好。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 victory_boss#10）

en: Draconis Veteran
zh: 德拉科尼斯老兵
note: 角色显示名（战斗 chatter 顶部）

en: All stations, this is the Captain. General Quarters… yeah, again. You know the drill by now.
zh: 全站注意，这里是舰长。战斗警报……对，又是战斗警报。流程你们都背熟了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#1）

en: Here we go, kids. Another glorious day in the Navy.
zh: 又来了，孩子们。海军又一个光荣的日子。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#2）

en: Systems green. Just like the last seventeen times. Let's try not to die today.
zh: 系统全绿。跟前十七次一样。今天争取别死。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#3）

en: Battle stations. Wake me when it's over.
zh: 战斗岗位。打完了叫醒我。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#4）

en: All hands, man your stations. Same shit, different sector.
zh: 全体就位。同样的破事，换个星域。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#5）

en: Always Above. Good hunting.
zh: 永居其上。狩猎顺利。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#6）

en: General Quarters, General Quarters. All hands man battle stations. ...You know where they are by now.
zh: 战斗警报，战斗警报。全员战斗岗位。……位置在哪你们早该知道了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#7）

en: TAO reports multiple hostile contacts. Guess someone didn't get the memo that I'm two years past retirement.
zh: 战术行动官报告多批敌对目标。看来有人没收到通知：我退役都超龄两年了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#8）

en: Condition One set throughout the ship. Coffee's still warm. Could be worse.
zh: 全舰一号战备。咖啡还热着。还不算最糟。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#9）

en: All stations, Captain has the CONN. Weapons hold until I say otherwise... let's see what we're dealing with.
zh: 全站注意，舰长接管指挥。武器管制，等我说另算……先看看对面是什么货色。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#10）

en: Hostile contacts, bearing zero-zero-zero. Right where intel said they wouldn't be.
zh: 敌对目标，方位零零零。情报说这儿绝不会有的，就在这儿。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#11）

en: Set General Quarters. And someone tell the XO his 'milk run' assessment aged poorly.
zh: 进入战斗警报。谁去告诉副长，他那句“轻松差事”的评估老得可以下葬了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#12）

en: Battle stations. No, I don't know why either. I just work here.
zh: 战斗岗位。别问为什么，我也不知道。我就是在这儿上班的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#13）

en: CIC reports firing solutions ready. Fancy that - something works for once.
zh: 作战情报中心报告射击解算就绪。稀罕——居然有东西能一次正常。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start#14）

en: Well look at that… another big bastard straight out of Hell. All right, let's dance.
zh: 瞧瞧这个……又一个地狱里直接开出来的大块头。行吧，跳支舞。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#1）

en: I've seen worse. Hell, I've killed worse. Bring it on.
zh: 我见过更糟的。得了，更糟的还是我杀的。放马过来。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#2）

en: We didn't crawl out of the civil war graveyard just to get scrapped by this thing.
zh: 我们从内战坟场里爬出来，不是为了栽在这种东西手里。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#3）

en: High-value target on scope. Finally something worth waking up for.
zh: 高价值目标入镜。可算有个值得醒来的东西。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#4）

en: Contact redesignated ALPHA. That's a big signature... remind me what we're getting paid again?
zh: 目标改判阿尔法。这信号可不小……再提醒我一次，我们的报酬是多少来着？
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#5）

en: Capital-class hostile on scope. Well, they said this deployment would be 'character building.'
zh: 主力级敌舰入镜。他们说这次部署能“磨砺品格”。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#6）

en: Tally on the command ship. All batteries, that's our dance partner. Try not to step on its toes.
zh: 目视指挥舰。所有炮组，那是我们的舞伴。踩脚趾头的事就别干了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#7）

en: Flag-level hostile confirmed. I was hoping to die in my sleep, but this works too.
zh: 将官级敌舰确认。我本想着在睡梦里死，不过这样也行。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#8）

en: High-value target, bearing dead ahead. Command wants it dead. Command isn't here, but fine.
zh: 高价值目标，正前方。司令部要它死。司令部人不在，行吧。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#9）

en: CIC, confirm that tonnage... yeah, that's what I thought. All hands, earn your hazard pay.
zh: 作战情报中心，确认吨位……嗯，跟我想的一样。全体，把你们的危险津贴挣回来。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 start_boss#10）

en: Weapons free. Let's get this over with.
zh: 自由开火。赶紧了结。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#1）

en: Contact. Engaging… because apparently retirement isn't an option.
zh: 接敌。开打……看样子退休是不给报了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#2）

en: Batteries released. Try to make your shots count, people, I'm tired of overtime.
zh: 炮组解禁。都打得准点，我可不想再加班。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#3）

en: Birds away. If they miss I'm writing everyone up.
zh: 导弹放出。再打偏我全员记过。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#4）

en: Here they come. Hold the line… or don't, I'm too old to care.
zh: 来了。守住战线……或者不守，我老了，管不动了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#5）

en: Weapons free, all mounts. Controlled pairs, make 'em count - quartermaster's already crying about expenditure.
zh: 全部挂点自由开火。短点射，打准——军需官已经在为消耗量哭娘了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#6）

en: Guns, guns, guns. Keep it steady, people. Panic is for the other guy.
zh: 开炮开炮开炮。稳住，各位。慌张是留给对面那位的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#7）

en: Good hits on target. Keep the pressure up, don't let them think.
zh: 命中良好。保持压力，别给他们思考的空。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#8）

en: Birds away, tracking true. Almost pretty, if you squint.
zh: 导弹放出，追踪正常。眯起眼看，还真有点好看。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#9）

en: TAO, shift fire to the wounded one. No sense letting them limp home to complain.
zh: 战术行动官，火力转受伤那个。别让他们瘸着回去告状。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#10）

en: Batteries released. I'll do the paperwork if we survive - When. When we survive.
zh: 炮组解禁。活着回去我就写报告——是“回去时”。回去时我们写。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#11）

en: Main battery engaging. Stay on target - I want to be home for chow.
zh: 主炮接战。咬住目标——我还赶着回去吃饭。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#12）

en: Hostile is maneuvering. Good. Means we've got their attention.
zh: 敌舰机动。很好。说明我们的招呼收到了。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#13）

en: Copy, valid hit. Now give them another one. And another. You get the idea.
zh: 收到，有效命中。再给他们一发。再来一发。领会精神。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#14）

en: This is what three decades of training looks like, kids. Savor it.
zh: 孩子们，这就是三十年训练的样子。好好品。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 engaged#15）

en: They're running. Cute. Maintain pursuit, let's finish the paperwork.
zh: 他们跑了。真可爱。保持追击，把收尾手续办完。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#1）

en: Don't let them get away. I hate writing 'inconclusive' in the after-action.
zh: 别让他们跑了。我最烦在战后报告里写“无结论”。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#2）

en: Press the attack. They started this, we're ending it.
zh: 压上攻击。他们起的头，我们来收尾。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#3）

en: Running won't save you, pal. I've chased worse through worse.
zh: 跑是没用的，伙计。更糟的地方我追过更糟的东西。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#4）

en: Target is breaking off. Maintain pursuit - I'm not filling out a 'target escaped' form.
zh: 目标脱离中。保持追击——我可不想填“目标逃脱”表。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#5）

en: Hostile attempting to disengage. Negative. Flank speed, keep them in the envelope.
zh: 敌舰试图脱战。否定。全速，别让他们出包线。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#6）

en: Contact is running. That's the smart move. Shame for them we're petty.
zh: 目标在跑。聪明。可惜我们小气。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#7）

en: They're bugging out. Helm, pursuit course. Let's finish what they started.
zh: 他们要溜。舵机，追击航向。把他们开头的事办完。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#8）

en: Hostile is displacing. Stay on them - wounded animals are still dangerous.
zh: 敌舰转移中。咬住——受伤的野兽照样咬人。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#9）

en: Fleeing enemy, bearing one-eight-five. Press the pursuit. I hate loose ends.
zh: 敌舰溃逃，方位一八五。继续追。我讨厌留尾巴。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 pursuing#10）

en: Tactical withdrawal. Living is a victory these days.
zh: 战术转移。活下来就算赢，这年头。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#1）

en: Disengaging. I didn't survive thirty years to die for a bonus.
zh: 脱离接触。我熬过三十年，不是为了份奖金死的。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#2）

en: Bug out. There's no medal for being a dead hero.
zh: 撤出。死了的英雄没奖章拿。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#3）

en: Pulling back. Tell the Admiral he can come fight the next one himself.
zh: 后撤。告诉元帅，下一个他可以自己来打。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#4）

en: All stations, tactical withdrawal. We'll call it a 'strategic redeployment' in the report.
zh: 全站注意，战术转移。报告里我们就写“战略重部署”。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#5）

en: Break contact, break contact. No shame in it - dead heroes buy no drinks.
zh: 脱离，脱离。不丢人——死了的英雄可请不了酒。
note: 战斗无线电台词（场景 running#6）
